findings.title: Eclypsium Launches InfraTrust to Centralize Enterprise Hardware Security Risks
findings.summary_md: Eclypsium announced InfraTrust on July 22, 2026 as a global infrastructure security intelligence database covering risks to enterprise hardware. The launch paired the database with a monthly advisory promising actionable risk data for protecting critical hardware infrastructure. The company presented the release as a way to centralize hardware security risks across enterprise infrastructure.

findings.title: InfraTrust Unlocks Critical Hardware Risk Intelligence
findings.summary_md: Eclypsium co-founder and CEO Yuriy Bulygin announced InfraTrust on July 22, 2026 as a global hardware infrastructure security knowledgebase. The post describes the project as a source of intelligence on security risks across hardware infrastructure and says the company is making mission-critical infrastructure security data available through it. It is the vendor's own announcement of the knowledgebase covered in the July news report.
